🚨🎖| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Albert Peris will be Barça U19's (Juvenil A’s) new HEAD COACH, replacing Pol Planas. The 38-year-old returned to Barça this summer and has been coaching Cadet B (U15). He previously worked as an assistant coach alongside García Pimienta. [@jaumemarcet] #fcblive

🚨🎙 Summary of Hansi Flick's press conference ahead of the big clash against Atlético Madrid:

🔹 On Eric García and Christensen: “Both will be in the squad and travel with us to Madrid. Eric can START, but we’ll decide later.”

🔹 On Rodri's replacement: “I haven’t decided who will start alongside Pedri. Frenkie can play in different positions and has more experience, not just as a number six. Bernal is also very good without the ball. I’m delighted to have Frenkie back, and he’s looking 100% in training. We’ll decide later.”

🔹 On managing Rodri’s minutes and his injury: “You can always do things better. But in this case, I communicated with an experienced player, asked him how he felt we should manage things, and we agreed on a plan together.” 

🔹 On Brian Fariñas: “He’s never played at RB before, but he’s physically, tactically and technically very good. His commitment and discipline is also incredible. I believe he’s ready to PLAY against Atlético, even from the start.”

🔹 On Koundé’s recovery: “We also expected him to return sooner, but we have to take care of him and assess his progress day by day. It’s taking a little longer than expected, and we hope to have him back after the int'l break.”

🔹 On Julián Álvarez and Barcelona’s past interest: “He’s a fantastic player, but he plays for Atlético. My job is to focus on my own team. I don’t like discussing players who belong to other clubs.” #fcblive
📸 | All smiles and fun in training today. #fcblive 😁
